title: The missing price feedback: Why studies overstate local grid peaks from synchronized home batteries under real-time pricing
abstract: arXiv:2609.35111v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Existing studies consistently find that home batteries optimized against real-time electricity prices create new load peaks in local distribution grids. This is because all assets respond to the same price signal in sync. However, most of these studies treat wholesale prices as exogenous, i.e., unaffected by that very response. This paper argues that treating prices as non-responsive biases the result: in reality, charging in low-price hours raises the wholesale price, which dampens the incentive to charge. In equilibrium, charging is spread out across hours. I test this by simulating households with rooftop solar and home batteries under a spot-based retail tariff, using a model of equilibrium wholesale prices calibrated to German data for 2025. With exogenous prices, my results confirm the finding from the previous literature: synchronous charging pushes the coincident import peak of the local grid to 83% above its no-battery level

translated_title: 缺失的价格反馈：为什么研究高估了实时定价下家用电池同步响应造成的局部电网峰值
translated_abstract: 现有研究一致发现，依据实时电价进行优化的家用电池会在局部配电网中造成新的负荷峰值，这是因为所有设备同步响应了相同的价格信号。然而，大多数此类研究将批发价格视为外生变量，即不受该响应行为本身的影响。本文认为，将价格视为非响应性的会使结果产生偏差：实际上，在低价时段充电会推高批发价格，从而削弱充电的激励。在均衡状态下，充电会分散到不同的时段。作者通过模拟在现货零售电价机制下拥有屋顶光伏和家用电池的家庭来检验这一观点，使用了基于2025年德国数据校准的均衡批发价格模型。在外生价格假设下，本文的结果证实了先前文献的发现：同步充电使局部电网的重合进口峰值推高至无电池水平的83%以上。
tldr: 本文指出，现有研究因忽略批发价格对家庭充电行为的价格反馈效应而高估了实时定价下家用电池同步充电对局部电网的峰值影响——在均衡状态下，低价时段的充电会推高批发价格，从而使充电分散到各个时段、缓解电网峰值问题。
